# Archived

This prompt belongs to an earlier Copilot-based continuation experiment.
Copilot is not part of the current Tethers workflow and this prompt must not:

- inspect or approve current work;
- compile or authorise a task;
- edit `docs/CURRENT_CLINE_TASK.md`;
- update the dashboard or trial log;
- route work to Cline or Codex;
- implement, commit, or push anything.

Current continuation is:

